output.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ol.product_id) AS distinct_products
FROM marts.fct_order_lines ol
JOIN marts.fct_orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN marts.dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.country = 'FR'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: This query counts the distinct products on order lines placed in 2025 by customers in France (country code 'FR'). Orders of every status are included (completed, cancelled, returned and open), so there is no filter on is_revenue. France is defined by the customer's country, not by the sales rep's region.
